title: CLEAR: Causal Context-Based Agentic Reasoning for Vulnerability Detection
title_zh: CLEAR：基于因果上下文的智能体推理用于漏洞检测
abstract_en: Detecting source code vulnerabilities is increasingly difficult as modern security flaws are rooted in complex causal dependencies between execution flows, control conditions, and program states. Despite recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) and multi-agent frameworks, existing approaches primarily address superficial similarities between benign and vulnerable functions while failing to capture the complex causal dependencies inherent in security flaws. To address these limitations, we propose Causal Context-based Agentic Reasoning (CLEAR), a novel multi-agent vulnerability detection framework integrated with a causal knowledge graph. CLEAR systematically constructs a Vulnerability Causal Knowledge Graph (VCKG) that models the causal chains between entrypoints, preconditions, root causes, and fix intents across vulnerability instances. Leveraging this structured knowledge, four specialized agents, including the Collector, Claim, Critic, and Judge, collaboratively verify vulnerability hypotheses through retrieved causal contexts. Experimental results on C/C++ and Java vulnerability benchmarks demonstrate that CLEAR improves Pair-Correct (P-C) performance by 130.7% and 71.56% over state-of-the-art approaches, demonstrating the effectiveness of causal knowledge graph-guided reasoning for automated vulnerability detection.
abstract_zh: 现代软件漏洞往往源于执行流、控制条件与程序状态之间复杂的因果依赖，使源代码漏洞检测愈发困难。现有基于 Large Language Models（LLMs）和 multi-agent frameworks 的方法，多侧重于捕捉良性函数与漏洞函数之间的表层相似性，难以建模安全缺陷背后的深层因果链。为此，论文提出 CLEAR（Causal Context-based Agentic Reasoning），一种结合因果知识图谱的多智能体漏洞检测框架。CLEAR 构建 Vulnerability Causal Knowledge Graph（VCKG），系统刻画漏洞实例中 entrypoints、preconditions、root causes 与 fix intents 之间的因果链关系。在此基础上，Collector、Claim、Critic 和 Judge 四类专门智能体利用检索到的因果上下文协同验证漏洞假设。实验表明，在 C/C++ 与 Java 漏洞检测基准上，CLEAR 相比现有最优方法的 Pair-Correct（P-C）性能分别提升 130.7% 和 71.56%，证明了因果知识图谱引导推理对自动化漏洞检测的有效性。
key_points_zh: 提出 CLEAR，将 causal knowledge graph 与 multi-agent reasoning 结合，用于捕捉漏洞形成过程中的深层因果依赖，而非仅依赖代码表层相似性。
构建 Vulnerability Causal Knowledge Graph（VCKG），显式建模 entrypoints、preconditions、root causes 和 fix intents 之间的因果链。
设计 Collector、Claim、Critic、Judge 四类智能体，通过检索因果上下文、提出漏洞假设、批判性验证和最终裁决来协同完成漏洞检测。
在 C/C++ 与 Java 漏洞基准上，CLEAR 相比 state-of-the-art 方法在 Pair-Correct（P-C）指标上分别提升 130.7% 和 71.56%。
结果表明，因果知识图谱引导的结构化推理能够显著提升 LLM-based 漏洞检测的准确性和鲁棒性。

llm_assessment.comment: A domain-specific multi-agent vulnerability detector using causal retrieval, but it is closer to an application method than agent harness evolution.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一种结合因果检索的领域型多智能体漏洞检测方法，更接近应用算法而非智能体运行体系演进。
